nodes.Name: mcache
nodes.DocComment:
Per-thread (in Go, per-P) cache for small objects.
This includes a small object cache and local allocation stats.
No locking needed because it is per-thread (per-P).

mcaches are allocated from non-GC'd memory, so any heap pointers
must be specially handled.

Fields.Name: nextSample
Fields.DocComment: trigger heap sample after allocating this many bytes

Fields.Name: memProfRate
Fields.DocComment: cached mem profile rate, used to detect changes

nodes.Name: gclink
nodes.DocComment:
A gclink is a node in a linked list of blocks, like mlink,
but it is opaque to the garbage collector.
The GC does not trace the pointers during collection,
and the compiler does not emit write barriers for assignments
of gclinkptr values. Code should store references to gclinks
as gclinkptr, not as *gclink.

nodes.Name: gclinkptr
nodes.DocComment:
A gclinkptr is a pointer to a gclink, but it is opaque
to the garbage collector.

nodes.Name: ptr
nodes.DocComment:
ptr returns the *gclink form of p.
The result should be used for accessing fields, not stored
in other data structures.

Fields.Name: size
Fields.DocComment: total size of stacks in list

nodes.Name: emptymspan
nodes.DocComment: dummy mspan that contains no free objects.

nodes.Name: freemcache
nodes.DocComment:
freemcache releases resources associated with this
mcache and puts the object onto a free list.

In some cases there is no way to simply release
resources, such as statistics, so donate them to
a different mcache (the recipient).

nodes.Name: getMCache
nodes.DocComment:
getMCache is a convenience function which tries to obtain an mcache.

Returns nil if we're not bootstrapping or we don't have a P. The caller's
P must not change, so we must be in a non-preemptible state.

nodes.Name: refill
nodes.DocComment:
refill acquires a new span of span class spc for c. This span will
have at least one free object. The current span in c must be full.

Must run in a non-preemptible context since otherwise the owner of
c could change.

nodes.Name: allocLarge
nodes.DocComment: allocLarge allocates a span for a large object.

nodes.Name: prepareForSweep
nodes.DocComment:
prepareForSweep flushes c if the system has entered a new sweep phase
since c was populated. This must happen between the sweep phase
starting and the first allocation from c.

nodes.Name: addReusableNoscan
nodes.DocComment:
addReusableNoscan adds a noscan object pointer to the reusable pointer free list
for a span class.

nodes.Name: hasReusableNoscan
nodes.DocComment:
hasReusableNoscan reports whether there is a reusable object available for
a noscan spc.
